objectives.description: Meaning and branches of mining; terminology used in mining; classification and importance of minerals.
Distribution of minerals in Nigeria; history of mining; mining activities in Nigeria; importance of minerals to man and national economy.
Minerals markets and cartels; mine accounting and sources of finance for mining ventures; aspects of Nigerian Minerals and Mining Act, 2007; mining titles acquisition.

subStrands.name: Geology, Earth Structure, Rocks and Minerals

objectives.description: Definition of geology and its scope; relationship between geology and mining; structure of the Earth; relative abundance of elements in the Earth's crust; economic mineral potentials of Nigeria.
Rocks and rock types (igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic); rock-forming minerals; physical and chemical properties of rock-forming minerals; rock cycle; weathering.

Simplified geological map of Nigeria; mineral map of Nigeria; collection and collation of geological data; interpretation of topographical and geological maps; drawing of simple geological cross-section.

subStrands.name: Mining Methods, Prospecting, Exploration and Feasibility

objectives.description: Classification of mining methods (surface and underground); choice of mining methods; surface mining methods (quarrying, open pit, open cast, alluvial); underground mining methods (room-and-pillar, longwall, cut-and-fill, shrinkage, block caving, sub-level); comparison and justification.
Prospecting stage: meaning and outlines of prospecting techniques (geological, geophysical, geochemical, remote sensing); exploration stage: meaning and classification of exploration techniques.

Meaning of feasibility study; financial analysis in mining; meaning of mine development; list of unit operations in mining (drilling, blasting etc.); need for mineral processing; unit operations in mineral processing; metal extraction (pyrometallurgy, hydrometallurgy, electrometallurgy).

Meaning of mineral processing, comminution terms, concentration terms, mill accounting terms; properties of minerals employed in mineral processing (specific gravity, magnetism etc.); main operations — comminution and concentration; products (concentrate, tailings, middling); dewatering; tailings disposal.

Meaning of gemology and lapidary; machines and tools in gemstone processing; meaning and properties of gemstones; types of gemstones based on shape, colour, size, refractive index; characteristics and identification of gemstones; unit of measurement; marketing and prices.

subStrands.name: Safety, Hazards, Environment and Mining Law

objectives.description: Health hazards in mining; safety requirements/measures; impacts of mining on the environment; safety equipment and apparels (personal protective equipment — PPE); common diseases associated with mining industry.

Administering simple first aid; guidelines for accident reporting; steps for environmental control; basic issues in National policy on mineral development; mining laws and regulations; environmental protection laws; National policy on the environment.
